PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  38300 SIERRA HWY, SUITE B
  PALMDALE, CA 93550 THURSDAY, JANUARY 13, 2022
  7:00 PM
  www.cityofpalmdale.org

  WELCOME

As a result of the dramatic increase in COVID-19 cases, and our desire to keep both the
public and City staff safe, the public will be permitted to physically attend the Planning
Commission meeting scheduled for January 13, 2022, including public seating available
at limited capacity. Masks are required to be worn by all persons in attendance. It is
recommended that all citizens practice social distancing to the extent possible while in
attendance. Planning Commissioners may choose to participate in person or via
conference call.
How to Observe the Meeting Virtually:
1. Spectrum local access Channel 27
2. Online live webcast at www.cityofpalmdale.org
How to Submit Public Comments:
VERBAL PUBLIC COMMENT DURING THE MEETING
ZOOM Numbers: 1-720-707-2699 or 1-253-215-8782
Webinar ID: 869 3661 0101
Passcode: 251588
Webinar attendee link:
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/86936610101?
pwd=Q3N1c2RSYlhQUHY0MXIxMkpqdzRNZz09
Verbal comments must be limited to three minutes. Public comments submitted will
become part of the official meeting record.
The safety and well-being of employees and the public remains the City's top priority.
 The City of Palmdale appreciates your patience and understanding during these
challenging times.
The Planning Commission is making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the
Brown Act and other applicable laws regulating the conduct of public meetings in order to
maximize transparency and public access.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-

Planning Commission  Thursday, January 13, 2022
 related modification or accommodation to participate in this meeting, please call the
Planning Division at (661) 267-5200 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.
If you require oral Spanish translation, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (661) 267-
5151 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meetings run smoothly. If you’ll be kind enough to
follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
• Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause,
comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
• Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning
Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted, and offenders will be asked to
leave the meeting.
• Please turn off / mute your cell phones and mobile devices.

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  8.A  Conditional Use Permit 21-005
  XOO&SHE, Inc., Applicant
  A request to establish a Type 47 (On-Sale General) Department of Alcoholic
  Beverage Control License for a proposed bona fide restaurant located at 422
  West Rancho Vista Boulevard Suite C-300.
  Staff Reference: Sarah Stachnik, Assistant Planner

Planning Commission  Thursday, January 13, 2022
   Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. PC-2022-001 approving
  Conditional Use Permit 21-005 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt
  from environmental review.
  CUP 21-005 PC SR.pdf

  8.B  Conditional Use Permit 21-006
  T-Mobile West, Applicant
  A request for the continued operation of an existing major wireless
  telecommunications facility located at 39724 30th Street West (Marie Kerr Park).
  Staff Reference: Sam Dominguez, Assistant Planner
  Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. PC-2022-002 approving
  Conditional Use Permit 21-006 and find that the project is consistent with the
  previously adopted Mitigative Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and
  Reporting Program.
  CUP 21-006 PC SR.pdf

  8.C  Environmental Document No. ENV 21-001
  Ravello Holdings, Applicant
  A request to consider an addendum to the previously approved Mitigated
  Negative Declaration for Tentative Tract Map 73068 for the subdivision of
  approximately 20 acres into 75 lots located south of Palmdale Boulevard and
  approximately 630 feet west of 55th Street East (APN: 3023-002-016).
  Staff Reference: Jasmine Alvarado, Assistant Planner
  Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. PC-2022-003 and find that the
  project will require minor clarifications to the previously adopted Mitigated
  Negative Declaration for TTM 73068 as outlined within the addendum (ENV 21-
  001).
  ED 21-001 PC SR.pdf
